title: device.property.set.acknowledged v1
description: Emitted when a device acknowledges a cloud-to-device property set command. The event records whether the command succeeded and can include the affected properties and the original protocol payload.

device_id.description: Stable device identifier within the tenant scope. Combined with tenant_id, uniquely identifies a device.

protocol.description: Protocol used by the device acknowledgement. For this MQTT route the value is mqtt.

success.description: Whether the device accepted and applied the property set command.

code.description: Optional device or protocol result code.

properties.description: Properties involved in the set acknowledgement, when reported by the device.

raw.description: Original protocol payload fields captured by the gateway. Consumers should not depend on specific fields here.
